senses.gloss: to dig. Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 11 כּוֹרֶה מנין how am I to know that he who digs a pit is responsible?—
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 51a:16">B. Kam. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>כורה אחר כורה</he> one who digs after another one, i.e. who completes the pit to its legal size.
Succ. 53ᵃ; Macc. 11ᵃ בשעה שכ׳ דוד וכ׳ when David dug for the foundations; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּרוּי, f. כְּרוּיָה hollowed out.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:5">Kel. III, 5</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="H00665"><he>חִידּוּק</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B01191"><he>בָּרָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to sit in a circle, v. infra.

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:5">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> (ref. to <he>כריתי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 50:5">Gen. L, 5</cite>) <he>הרבה ממון תַּכְרֶה עליה</he> much money shalt thou pile up (give me) for it (the grave); (some ed. <he>הכרה</he> Jacob piled up in settling with Esau).

<cite ref="Genesis 50:5">Ib.</cite> <he>הִכְרֵתִי</he> (corr. <he>הִכְרֵיתִי</he>); v. <cite ref="K01153"><he>כְּרִי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 1:1">Pesik. R. s. 1</cite> <he>וכל ממון שהיה לו ה׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>מסר לו</he>) and he (Jacob) piled up whatever money he had to place it before Esau &c.
